hard_spam_signals._note: Generic web-form spam (Todd's site was ~96% this). Honeypot + a bot check catches most automated spam before this; the keyword list is the backstop for what gets through. Match = block/quarantine, do not create a lead.

anti_icp_keywords._note: Real people, wrong fit. PRL compounds resin PELLETS; it does not make sheet/rod/film/finished stock. Match = do not discard; PREQUAL + soft-route ('we make X, are you sure?') and tag low-intent so reps triage. This is Todd's 'sheet seekers' problem from the Aug 10 call.
